title: plan subset check reads every backticked token in a Modules touched bullet as a module path
detail: Surfaced planning model-tier-policy: a Modules touched bullet whose description backticks an identifier (e.g. a function name) is read as an extra module path, so the plan-vs-scope subset check fails until the planner strips the backticks from the prose. The path token should be the bullet's first token only (as schema.extract_path_token does for scope).
